Knud Anderson Farmstead

files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Knud Anderson Farmstead
The lower level of the barn is accessible through two large openings on the east side of the

barn. It was likely used to house animals as there is a feed trough that bisects this level.

files.caption:
Knud Anderson Farmstead
The metal roof was installed in the 1990s with metal gutters and lightning rods on the peak that feature remnants of metal animal vanes (unknown dates).
